scope: Outcome-blind feasibility audit for a strictly prior, multi-reference Sentinel-2 bank on authorized MARS folds 3/4. This is an information-acquisition audit, not a model experiment.

rationale.failure_mode: Repeated scene-head, dense-to-scene, product-alignment, synthetic, and released-proposal experiments over the fixed single-reference MARS tensors are saturated. Independent controlled releases show that the current champion can miss emissions detected by the released model.
rationale.new_information: Use other strictly earlier, same-site Sentinel-2 target observations as candidate reference frames rather than fitting another head over the existing target/reference pair.
rationale.architecture_if_later_authorized: A reference-set temporal Vision Transformer will encode target/candidate pairs and attend over reference tokens, but it is authorized only after a separate frozen alternate-reference score extraction demonstrates complementary positive signal.
rationale.not_a_repeat_of_site_templates: Earlier site-template experiments aggregated derived score/probability/MBMP maps after the fixed target/reference pair had already been processed. This audit selects and later re-pairs raw six-band target imagery before methane inference.

evidence: The production Sentinel-2 model uses two cloud-filtered prior reference scenes.
The authors identify methane-contaminated or surface-mismatched references as a false-negative mechanism observed in controlled releases.
Their proposed research directions include averaging the last 5/10 overpasses, similarity-based reference selection, and learned attention over references.
project_eucalyptus.released_model_use: not authorized here; its 24-channel input requires B05/B07/B8A absent from the six-band MARS contract, and the released file is a whole-object PyTorch pickle rather than a weights-only artifact

zhao_dsan_2025.exclusion: all 1,627 public images come from six sites overlapping both MARS development and official-test geography within 0.216 km

selection.landsat_policy: No alternate Landsat reference is selected; all later Landsat model scores and masks must remain exact champion identities until a separately preregistered reprojection-aware path exists.
selection.descriptor: Per-band median-normalized 16x16 average-pooled target texture. Distance is mean absolute texture difference plus 0.25 times mean absolute log median-reflectance ratio.
selection.selection_order: Among the ten most recent eligible prior observations, choose the five smallest frozen descriptor distances with stable row-order tie breaking.
selection.fallback: If no eligible reference exists, use the original MARS pair only in any later inference experiment.

feasibility_gates.pass_action: Preregister and run a frozen released-model alternate-reference score extraction and a diagnostic of complementarity versus the Gaussian+DOFA champion.
feasibility_gates.failure_action: Stop the reference-set path before model inference.

invariants: The builder never accesses manifest label fields or non-image asset paths.
Only B02/B03/B04/B08 target pixels can influence reference selection; B11/B12, masks, fluxes, and outcomes cannot.
Every selected observation is strictly earlier than its target and belongs to the same physical site, Sentinel-2 sensor family, MGRS tile, CRS, and affine grid.
No model is loaded, trained, scored, calibrated, or selected in this audit.
Fold 2, folds 0/1, MethaneS2CM held development, external outcomes, and official paper outcomes remain unavailable to this audit.
Bulk descriptor and selection artifacts remain ignored and only compact reports may be committed.
claim_boundary: Passing this audit establishes only that a leakage-safe prior-reference set is available. It does not establish methane signal, model improvement, calibration, or superiority.
